requirement.original: 系统性修复 session recovery 的全局 restore 连锁反应：启动任何一个 daemon 会 kill+respawn 所有 daemon 的 session
requirement.clarified: Scope all session save/restore/kill operations per-HAPPY_HOME_DIR to prevent cross-daemon cascade
success_criteria: Restarting one daemon does NOT affect sessions of other daemons
Global save/restore still works when --home is not specified
Session watcher continues to monitor all homes
Invalid --home values fail safely without fallback to global

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Starting happy-daemon-qijie killed and respawned ALL 11 sessions across all 4 homes
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: happy-daemon-post-start.sh calls restore globally; restore iterates ALL HAPPY_HOMES killing orphans and respawning regardless of which daemon triggered the start

development_approach.strategy: Add --home parameter to session-recovery.sh save/restore; update post-start.sh to forward HAPPY_HOME_DIR; update all service files

safety_rules: systemctl daemon-reload after service file changes
